sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the Petitioner and learned counsel for the State.

2. The Petitioner is an accused in connection with Spl. G.R. Case No.47 of 2022 pending on the file of learned Ad-hoc Additional Sessions Judge, FTSC-II, Cuttack arising out of Chauliaganj P.S. Case No.111 of 2022 for commission of offence alleged under Sections 376(2)(n) of IPC read with Section 6 of POCSO Act.
3. Learned counsel, on instruction, submits that except the present BLAPL, no other bail application of the Petitioner relating to the aforementioned P.S. case is pending in any other Court.

4. Being aggrieved by the rejection of his application for bail U/s.483 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita (BNSS) by the learned Ad-hoc Additional District & Sessions Judge, FTSC-II,
Cuttack

entities.text:
Additional District & Sessions Judge, FTSC-II,
Cuttack
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: by order dated 21.09.2024 in the aforementioned cases, the present BLAPL has been filed.
5. This is the second journey of the Petitioner to this Court.
Earlier this Court by order dated 03.02.2023 directed release of the Petitioner in BLAPL No.11027 of 2022 and accordingly, the Petitioner was released on bail.
6. Since the Petitioner violated the terms on which the bail was granted by non-appearance on 03.08.2024, he was taken into custody in execution of NBW(A) on 01.09.2024.

sentences.text:
It is submitted by the learned counsel that the non-appearance on the date of default was for reasons beyond the control of the Petitioner and he has been appearing regularly.
8.
Learned counsel for the State opposes the prayer for bail.

9. Taking into account that the Petitioner was granted bail and the reasons advanced for non- appearance on the date fixed, this Court directs the Petitioner to be released on bail on such terms to be fixed by the learned Court in seisin.
10. Accordingly, the BLAPL stands disposed of.
11. Urgent certified copy of this order be granted as per the rules.
Signed by: SANTOSHI LENKA (V. NARASINGH)
